## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and before/after behavior. Link the issue (Closes #…).

## Scope

Explain affected components and any deliberate exclusions or contract changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` — include actual result
- [ ] `npm run test:smoke` for UI/API changes — include result or reason not applicable
- [ ] Tests use isolated data; no secrets or runtime artifacts included
- [ ] Docs reflect changed commands and behavior

## Risks / remaining work

List unverified behavior, known failures and follow-up issues. Do not mark checks
complete unless they were run against this change.
